title: Income Tax Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 7 Posts
content:
Income Tax Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026: 7 Vacancies, 10th Pass Apply Online

Last Updated: 3 August 2026

The Income Tax Department, Madhya Pradesh & Chhattisgarh Region, Bhopal has been reported to have released a short recruitment notice for 7 Canteen Attendant posts in its non-statutory Departmental Canteen. The posts are Group C positions carrying Pay Level-1 (₹18,000–56,900).

According to the available recruitment short-notice information, candidates who have passed Class 10 (Matriculation) and satisfy the prescribed age requirement can apply. The online application window is scheduled to open on 11 August 2026, with 31 August 2026 up to 11:00 PM given as the closing deadline.

Candidates interested in Income Tax Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026 should note that, as of 3 August, the application window has not opened yet. Applicants should verify the detailed advertisement and application instructions on the Income Tax Department MP & CG regional website when the recruitment link becomes active.

Latest Update

A short notice for Income Tax MPCG Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026 has been reported on 3 August 2026. It announces 7 Canteen Attendant vacancies, with applications scheduled from 11 August to 31 August 2026.

Current Status: Application yet to start.

Candidates should check the official MP & CG Income Tax Department portal before applying, particularly for the detailed advertisement, category-wise vacancies, fee, selection procedure and other conditions that are not fully established from the presently available short-notice information.

How to Apply Online for Income Tax Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026

The application process is scheduled to begin on 11 August 2026.

Once the official application facility becomes available, candidates should:

  1. Visit the official Income Tax Department Madhya Pradesh & Chhattisgarh regional website.

  2. Locate the relevant Canteen Attendant recruitment notice/application announcement.

  3. Download and read the detailed advertisement carefully.

  4. Confirm your age, educational qualification and other eligibility conditions.

  5. Open the official online application link.

  6. Complete the registration process with the required details.

  7. Fill in the application form accurately.

  8. Upload the required photograph, signature and/or documents according to the prescribed specifications.

  9. Pay the application fee only if one is officially prescribed.

  10. Review all information before final submission.

  11. Submit the application by 31 August 2026, 11:00 PM.

  12. Save the submitted application/acknowledgement for future reference.

Candidates should follow the exact instructions displayed on the official recruitment portal once applications open.
